properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/flutter-silver' | fields @timestamp, ingest_date, Entity, RowsIngested, RowCount, RowsQuarantined, ChecksTotal, DuplicateKeys, BlankValues, FormatViolations, OutOfRangeNumerics, FutureDatedRecords, ProcessingDurationMs
| filter ispresent(Entity)
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 30
properties.title: Per entity — ingested, written to silver, quarantined

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/flutter-silver' | fields @timestamp, entity, column, check, severity, failed_records, failed_ratio, passed, details
| filter dq_check = 1
| sort @timestamp desc, failed_records desc
| limit 30
properties.title: Imperfections by column — passed=0 means the contract tolerance was exceeded
